top_signals.title: Stocks Eke Out Gains Before Jobs Data as Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders refrained from making big bets in the run-up to Friday’s jobs report as higher oil prices raised concerns about inflation and lifted bond yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Daly Says Fed Needs to Guard Against Inflation 'Drift'
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco President Mary Daly says "alarm bell" isn't sounding off yet on longer-run inflation expectations during an event in Tokyo. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Warner Bros. Revenue Falls, But Focus Is on Planned Merger
top_signals.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. reported a drop in sales due to the loss of a deal to carry National Basketball Association games and its summer movie lineup has not performed well. But all eyes are on the planned acquisition by Paramount Skydance. Geetha Ranganathan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lufthansa breaks ground on Philippine maintenance site for widebody planes
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Colombia Peso Defies Central Bank Bid to Halt Carry-Fueled Rally
top_signals.summary: The Colombian peso continues to be the best performing currency in emerging markets as investors shrug off the central bank’s efforts to slow the currency’s rally and instead focus on its carry appeal.

top_signals.title: SpaceX Shares Steady After $100 Billion Insider Lockup Expires
top_signals.summary: SpaceX shares held steady on Thursday as investors digested the release of as many as 911.5 million shares worth about $100 billion from lock-up agreements that had prevented insiders from selling them.
